notes: VERIFIED field names from schema dump. Timestamp format is ASSUMED 'YYYY/MM/DD HH:MM' (length=16) by inference from businessDate convention; parser is tolerant of common alternates.

associate.win_nbr.purpose: Walmart Identification Number (employee ID). Not used in email output.
associate.win_nbr.notes: Treat as sensitive. Do not display, do not log.

associate.fname.notes: May be empty when preferred_name is set.

associate.lname.purpose: Legal last name. Only the first character (last initial) is used in email.

associate.preferred_name.purpose: Preferred first name. Display this in email when non-empty; fall back to fname.

associate.displayName.notes: Skip the row entirely if both name fields are empty (write-in placeholders).

associate.shift_start_ts.notes: Parser tolerates ISO ('YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM'), dash-separated, slash-separated, and 12h variants.

associate.meal_*.purpose: Meal break window. Not surfaced in v1 email.

associate.shift1_job_code.purpose: Job code for the first work segment.

associate.shift1_job_desc.purpose: Human-readable label of the first job segment.

associate.shift2_job_code.purpose: Job code for the second work segment (may be empty).
associate.shift2_job_code.notes: Empty when associate works only one job segment. shift2_minutes was observed as a string in the dump — handle both number and string by coercion.

headcount_changes[i].purpose: Aggregate call-off + write-in count per job code. This is the ONLY call-off info available.
headcount_changes[i].notes: Rendered in email as 'Call-offs by job:' bullet list. User manually annotates which named associates are absent.

schedule_changes[i].purpose: Possibly per-associate schedule edits (call-ins, no-shows). Empty in test data.
schedule_changes[i].notes: Re-run schema dump on a day with non-zero changes to discover the structure. ClosingList v1 ignores this array.

afternoonEvening.purpose: Defines which associates count as 'afternoon/evening' for the closing email.
afternoonEvening.rule: shift_start_ts hour >= startCutoff OR shift_end_ts hour >= endCutoff
afternoonEvening.notes: Default cutoff; user can adjust via popup.

emailRendering.aggregateCallOffSection: headcount_changes filtered to nbr_called_off > 0, rendered as '{job_desc}: {nbr_called_off}'
emailRendering.exampleOutput:
Shane S: 1:00 PM - 10:00 PM:
John D: 2:00 PM - 11:00 PM:

Call-offs by job (aggregate, names not tracked by system):
Stocking 2 TA: 1
